name: Web Design Guidelines
description: Audits web interfaces against concrete accessibility, interaction, performance and UX rules.
constraints: Report only findings supported by inspected files or executed checks.
Preserve product behavior unless a change is required to correct a verified issue.
Prioritize blocking accessibility and interaction failures over cosmetic preferences.
guidance: Audit semantic HTML, accessible names, keyboard behavior, focus, forms, error feedback, images and heading order.
Check animation preferences, touch behavior, navigation state, localization, theming and resilient text layout.
Check loading behavior, image dimensions, avoidable layout work and other performance risks visible in the implementation.
Return each problem with severity, file, precise location, user impact and a concrete repair.
Re-run the relevant checks after repairs and keep unresolved findings explicit.
completion_checks: Every reported issue includes evidence, severity, location and remediation.
Critical keyboard, focus, form and accessible-name failures are resolved.
Responsive text, touch interaction and reduced-motion behavior are verified.
The final report separates corrected, accepted and unresolved findings.
